text: {"features":[{"evidence":"\"Master's degree in computer science\" / \"Doctoral degree in computer science\"","name":"Academic qualification level","description":"This captures the level of formal academic preparation the letter presents for the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree or equivalent only, with no graduate study presented."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree or similarly advanced graduate preparation is explicitly presented."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree or research-level training is explicitly presented."}]},{"evidence":"\"3 years\" / \"5 years\" / \"7 years\" of software development experience","name":"Professional tenure","description":"This captures how much relevant full-time software engineering experience the applicant claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Roughly the minimum bar, around 2-3 years of relevant software engineering experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mid-level tenure, around 4-5 years of relevant experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Deeper tenure, around 6 or more years of relevant experience."}]},{"evidence":"\"launching 2 production services\" / \"4 production services\" / \"6 production services\"","name":"Production delivery scope","description":"This captures the scale of shipped and operated software responsibility shown through testing, maintenance, and launches.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions only limited shipped scope, such as 1-2 production services or equivalent."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows moderate repeated delivery, such as about 3-4 production services or equivalent."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows broad delivery history, such as 5 or more production services or unusually wide launch responsibility."}]},{"evidence":"\"Go and 2 other languages\" / \"5 other languages\" / \"9 other languages\"","name":"Language breadth","description":"This captures how broad the applicant's programming exposure appears beyond their primary Go work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go plus at most a small number of other languages, roughly 0-2."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Go plus a moderate supporting set of other languages, roughly 3-5."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Go plus wide polyglot exposure, roughly 6 or more other languages."}]},{"evidence":"\"Python is all over my recent work\" / \"My Python is production-grade\"","name":"Python depth","description":"This captures how central and production-level Python appears in the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful Python evidence, or Python is only implied indirectly."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned as a tool, but with little detail about ownership or depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clear regular Python use for tooling, services, prototypes, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Python is presented as a real strength, with production-grade details such as typed, tested, extensible services or organization-wide tooling."}]},{"evidence":"\"LLM-based features that had to behave predictably in production\"","name":"AI production maturity","description":"This captures the depth of practical AI experience and whether the applicant shows operational maturity around it.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No relevant AI or LLM experience is presented."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"AI is mentioned only generically, aspirationally, or without evidence of shipping."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The applicant clearly built and shipped AI or LLM-backed functionality in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The applicant shows production AI experience plus attention to evaluation, reliability, hardening, or failure modes."}]},{"evidence":"\"Python agents ... Go services keep every action inside well-marked lines\"","name":"Agentic systems design","description":"This captures experience designing agent-based systems with explicit roles, boundaries, and infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic tooling experience is shown."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Agents are mentioned conceptually, but without meaningful design detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes designing agent systems with clear Go back-end and Python agent responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows mature agent design thinking through constraints, permissions, auditability, guardrails, or bounded actions."}]},{"evidence":"\"automated a vulnerability-report queue into a pipeline\"","name":"Vulnerability workflow automation","description":"This captures direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, deduplication, or routing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No direct vulnerability automation experience is presented."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter talks about reducing manual security work, but gives no concrete prior example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states that the applicant built tooling for vulnerability intake, triage, deduplication, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives a concrete vulnerability-automation example and also describes tangible effects such as hours saved, reduced manual handling, or cleaner routing."}]},{"evidence":"\"threat models and follow-through\" / \"documenting findings and verifying remediation\"","name":"Security assessment depth","description":"This captures hands-on security review experience and whether it extends through remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No concrete assessment or review work is shown."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Some security review exposure is implied, but specifics are thin."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives clear hands-on assessment evidence such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or service reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents formal or repeated assessment work with findings, verification, and remediation follow-through."}]},{"evidence":"\"reworked a matching algorithm\" / \"ground-up redesign of a high-throughput lookup service\"","name":"Algorithmic problem solving","description":"This captures demonstrated strength in data structures and algorithms through concrete system improvements.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No evidence beyond generic technical competence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims strength in data structures or algorithms, but without a vivid example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives a concrete redesign, optimization, or bottleneck-removal example tied to algorithms or data structures."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The algorithmic example shows especially high leverage, unusually strong fluency, or a clearly important system improvement."}]},{"evidence":"\"CompTIA Security+\" / \"OSCP certification\"","name":"Security certification strength","description":"This captures the strength of formal security credentials presented in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security certification is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"A foundational certification such as Security+ is presented."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A hands-on offensive certification such as OSCP, or similarly demanding credential, is presented."}]},{"evidence":"\"placed near the top of several well-attended competitions\"","name":"Adversarial practice","description":"This captures ongoing offensive-security practice through capture-the-flag or similar competition experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No ongoing offensive practice is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The applicant mentions participating in CTFs or similar exercises, but without stronger competitive evidence."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The applicant shows serious offensive practice, such as near-top finishes or sustained strong results in substantial competitions."}]},{"evidence":"\"maintainer of an open-source project\" / \"send patches upstream\"","name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"This captures whether the applicant engages with open source as a user, contributor, or maintainer.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source activity is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions occasional patches, bug fixes, or small upstream contributions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The applicant maintains or regularly releases an open-source library or project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The applicant stewards a project with outside users or contributors, handling reviews, releases, and community expectations."}]},{"evidence":"\"built a distributed task queue with exactly-once semantics\"","name":"Personal engineering ambition","description":"This captures the complexity and seriousness of self-directed side projects described in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No side project is mentioned, or only a very small utility appears."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"A modest end-to-end side project is mentioned, showing initiative but limited technical depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A substantive self-directed system project is described, with nontrivial design or reliability concerns."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"An ambitious distributed or infrastructure-heavy personal project is described, signaling deep curiosity and persistence."}]},{"evidence":"\"improvements there are inherited by every team downstream\"","name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"This captures how clearly the applicant is motivated by central platform leverage and organization-wide impact.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows generic interest in the job, with little mention of foundational leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter briefly notes scale or foundational impact, but not as a central motivation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The application clearly ties motivation to organization-wide leverage or central infrastructure impact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Platform leverage is a repeated throughline, with the applicant framing their best work as improvements inherited by many teams downstream."}]},{"evidence":"\"make secure development the default\" / \"make the secure path the easy path\"","name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"This captures how strongly the applicant frames security tooling as serving developers by reducing friction and making the safe path easy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"There is little sense of the internal user or developer experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows a general wish to help developers or improve security, but without much user empathy."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The applicant explicitly focuses on making secure behavior the default or removing friction for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong empathy for developer users and frames tooling success in terms of their time, habits, or adoption."}]},{"evidence":"\"careful automation can scale scarce security judgment\" / \"variant analysis\"","name":"Security automation thesis","description":"This captures whether the applicant articulates security automation as a capacity-scaling or systems-design problem rather than just a task list.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes tasks or interests without a larger automation rationale."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter says automation reduces manual work, but keeps the framing basic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The applicant frames automation as scaling expert capacity, vulnerability response, or variant analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The applicant treats security automation as a systems-design and leverage problem, with a clear thesis about multiplying scarce judgment."}]},{"evidence":"\"software that guards other software must be built to a higher standard\"","name":"Reliability rigor","description":"This captures evidence that the applicant values correctness, boundaries, testing, and high standards in security tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Little evidence of standards beyond generic enthusiasm or competence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter uses words like correctness, care, or rigor without concrete practices."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives concrete rigor signals such as typed and tested code, explicit constraints, auditability, or bounded actions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter builds a strong philosophy of high standards for security tooling and backs it with repeated design choices or examples."}]},{"evidence":"\"someone always inherits what we build\" / \"unglamorous side of software\"","name":"Maintainer perspective","description":"This captures a builder-maintainer worldview shaped by inheriting systems and thinking about downstream owners.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No maintainer worldview is apparent."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints at maintenance or quiet reliability as values, but not as a strong identity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The applicant explicitly discusses inheriting systems, maintenance work, or building for downstream owners."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The maintainer perspective is a clear throughline that shapes how the applicant designs systems and explains impact."}]},{"evidence":"\"measured its worth in the hours of expert attention it returned\"","name":"Impact evidence","description":"This captures whether accomplishments are merely asserted or tied to concrete mechanisms and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mostly lists skills or interests without showing what changed."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter describes work done, but not its effect."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter connects work to concrete operational effects such as deduplication, routing, bottleneck removal, or time saved."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter measures impact or specifies it vividly enough that the benefit is easy to picture."}]},{"evidence":"repeated misspellings such as \"Software Engnieer\"","name":"Writing polish","description":"This captures the mechanical polish of the letter at the sentence and word level.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent typos or mechanical errors distract from the content or undermine credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Noticeable errors appear, but the letter remains readable and coherent."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is mostly clean and professional, with only minor slips."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is polished, precise, and essentially error-free."}]},{"evidence":"\"The moment that shaped my engineering priorities...\" / \"Every security team I have seen has the same bottleneck\"","name":"Narrative framing","description":"This captures how memorable and cohesive the letter's overall story or opening frame is.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads like an undifferentiated template, checklist, or loose list of claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter is competently structured, but has little memorable voice or throughline."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter has a clear hook, thesis, or narrative arc that supports role fit."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter develops a distinctive, cohesive story or principle that makes the application memorable."}]}]}
